blocker_dispositions.change: Boolean startedAtGenRef withdrawn; replaced by admission epoch (docId, genId, epochSeq).

details.epoch_seq: monotonic counter bumped synchronously on every doc change and genId change; opening an epoch opens its exempt batch
details.admission_while_open: every page passing the ordinary active-set guard is admitted (whole initial window; every active page after a zoom/fit commit)
details.batch_close_rule: first visible-set mutation occurring after the batch has admitted >= 1 page; never reopens
details.close_rationale: prior-admission requirement makes cold start correct because the IO mutation is itself what makes initial pages active; subsequent-mutation requirement keeps later scroll entries out of a serving batch
details.await_behavior: admission decided synchronously at ensureRendered entry before any await; epochSeq token revalidated after every await alongside dispose/gen/active checks; mismatch abandons without starting
details.bound: at most one window of exempt starts per epoch; P-3 scroll is a single epoch
